verses.english: “Mendicants, it’s because of breaking seven things that you become a mendicant.

verses.pali: Sakkāyadiṭṭhi bhinnā hoti, vicikicchā bhinnā hoti, sīlabbataparāmāso bhinno hoti, rāgo bhinno hoti, doso bhinno hoti, moho bhinno hoti, māno bhinno hoti.
verses.english: Substantialist view, doubt, misapprehension of precepts and observances, greed, hate, delusion, and conceit.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, sattannaṁ dhammānaṁ bhinnattā bhikkhu hotī”ti.
verses.english: It’s because of breaking these seven things that you become a mendicant.”
